# [F3 — Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_f3.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-NEEDS">[F3](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae") needs the eelgrass depth limit and cover by station and year, from ODA's vegetation topics; none of them is held here, and `scripts/fetch_oda.py` does not list them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-NEEDS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can fail

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-MECH">[F3](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae") says vegetation loss is self-reinforcing: cover goes, the bed resuspends, the water darkens, and the darkness prevents return. Two consequences follow that can each be wrong.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-MECH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-C1">**`C1` (the feedback).** At a transect, a drop in vegetation **cover** is followed by a rise in local light attenuation, more strongly than a rise in attenuation is followed by a drop in cover. *Falsified* if the cross-lagged asymmetry is zero or reversed under the nulls below — which is what "the water darkened first, for its own reasons" looks like.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-C1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-C2">**`C2` (the block).** Transects that lost cover stay light-limited: light at the bed remains below the eelgrass requirement. *Falsified* by transects where light at the bed has been adequate for [5](../SOURCES.md#F-1b8d5655f5) consecutive growth seasons and cover has not returned.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-C2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-SEP">`C1` and `C2` are separable. `C1` can hold and `C2` fail — the feedback is real and something else now holds the system down.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-SEP "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Avoiding the circularity, and what stays circular

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-CIRC">The eelgrass **depth limit** is, in DCE's words, an indicator of eutrophication and of the bottom-vegetation quality element, and light attenuation is the factor that matters most for it; the national models express the depth limit through Kd. Regressing it on attenuation re-reads the relation the indicator is built on, not [F3](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae").</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-CIRC "What this claim rests on")</sup> The defences:

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-D1">**The response is cover, not depth limit.** Cover per species (`Daekningsgrad (%)`) is its own field in the vegetation topics, apart from the depth limits, and the Danish indicator, as the source register records, uses the main-distribution depth limit. The depth-limit columns are used only as a covariate, to check `C1` is not driven by them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-D1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-D2">**Drop light-limited transects from the depth-limit checks.** The source register records a vegetation field, `Maks dybde begraenset af`, naming why the transect stopped. Where the answer is substrate or end-of-transect, the depth limit is not a light measurement by construction. The field is counted for fill first, and the depth-limit strand runs only on the transects that carry it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-D2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-D3">**Clarity is measured, not inferred.** `LyssvaekkelsesKoefficient` per cast in the light extract, and the daily satellite attenuation `KD490` in the held CMEMS transparency files — neither derived from vegetation.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-D3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-STAYS">**What stays circular and cannot be removed:** the light requirement `C2` needs — the share of surface light eelgrass needs at the bed — is physiology, not measured here, and no document pinned in this project gives it. This project's light analysis carries two values for it, [11](../SOURCES.md#F-e0cd5a53f8)% and [14](../SOURCES.md#F-5621596820)% of surface light, as parameters of its own code with no source recorded. If the requirement is wrong, the adequacy call moves with it, so `C2` is reported across requirements from [8](../SOURCES.md#F-dfae2980f7)% to [20](../SOURCES.md#F-a8a4b5f18f)% rather than at one threshold.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-STAYS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held, counted here

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-LYS">`data/raw/oda/lys.csv.gz` holds [2,370,091](../SOURCES.md#F-d9b22c989d) records at [566](../SOURCES.md#F-c9c0e8b759) stations with coordinates.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-LYS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-STARTDEPTH">Its apparent Kd depends on where a cast starts: this project's light analysis gives a median Kd of [0.35](../SOURCES.md#F-f8f56b7f48) and a median depth reaching [11](../SOURCES.md#F-e0cd5a53f8)% of surface light of [6.31](../SOURCES.md#F-b5f33a89f8) m for casts starting above [2](../SOURCES.md#F-5a6a77bc92) m, against [0.27](../SOURCES.md#F-341b020904) and [8.18](../SOURCES.md#F-301a45c3f7) m for casts starting below. Two answers in one column, so Kd is stratified by start depth, never pooled.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-STARTDEPTH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-VEG">ODA's vegetation topics — eelgrass with bottom fauna, with macroalgae, and the plant itself (`Emne_3_180`, `Emne_3_181`, `Emne_3_182`) — are not held. This project's source register records them, from an authenticated enumeration, as per-transect surveys carrying cover per species, the maximum and main-distribution depth limits, the maximum water depth, the bottom type, epiphyte and drifting-macroalgae cover, and why the transect stopped; each lists fewer stations under the portal's default period than with a period set.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-VEG "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-FITTED">Use the per-transect observed depth limit, never an indicator's fitted one: a fitted depth limit is a model output, and testing a model's output against its own input tests the model.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-FITTED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-REG">`data/raw/oda/stations.csv`, the ODA station register, holds [798,574](../SOURCES.md#F-bd74e20689) records for [6,288](../SOURCES.md#F-1acb8bcb68) stations, [2,329](../SOURCES.md#F-bd2a4e4894) of them with a transect end coordinate; its dates run from 1911-05-17 to 2026-09-04.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-REG "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-IDS">The register carries only [34](../SOURCES.md#F-9fee8eb468) of the [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-a65709e687) stations of the monthly series built from the CTD extract, so its identifiers are not the extracts'; a transect is joined to light casts by distance, not by id.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-IDS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-JOIN">Where a light cast lies within [2](../SOURCES.md#F-fd7e9a24fa) km of a transect, the transect's clarity comes from it; where none does, from CMEMS pixels. The share of transects the radius keeps is reported with the result.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-JOIN "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-MAAL">`data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz` holds [151,203](../SOURCES.md#F-5683df4d6c) records, at [1,176](../SOURCES.md#F-b78e848332) stations with a bottom depth, and carries `BundDybde_m` and `SigtTilBund`; its Secchi depths are censored at the bed, far more often in shallow water ([D7](../hypodrafts/D7.md "Storm-driven resuspension") counts it).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-MAAL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-GEUS">`data/raw/geus/seabed_sediment_dk.gpkg`, the GEUS seabed-sediment map, is read with `sqlite3` by `scripts/substrate.py`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-GEUS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-TRANSP">`data/raw/cmems/grid/` holds the CMEMS satellite transparency product as one file per year for the inner waters and for the Arkona basin, `transp__inner__YYYY.nc` and `transp__arkona__YYYY.nc`, each with the daily diffuse attenuation `KD490`; they are streamed one year at a time.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-TRANSP "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-NOTUSABLE">**Not usable here:** `docs/data/areas/val_kd.bin` and the coverage cube are indexed by marine water body, a unit in which this project's partition work finds no measured signal. Clarity must come from per-cast light profiles or per-pixel CMEMS.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-NOTUSABLE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The fetch, specified, not run

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-FETCH">Add the three vegetation topics to the `TOPICS` of `scripts/fetch_oda.py`, one entry each (`{"emne": "Emne_3_182"}` and its siblings), and run each with an explicit period: `--from 1970-01-01 --to 2026-12-31 --years 5`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-FETCH "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-PERIOD">Without a period ODA returns only the currently active network, and `fetch_oda.py` refuses to extract without one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-PERIOD "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null, computed under the constraint actually imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-NULLS">The nulls are computed, not quoted: a temporal one and a spatial one, because either time or place could fake the result.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-NULLS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-N1">**`N1`, temporal.** For `C1`: circularly shift each transect's cover series against its own clarity series by a random whole number of years, at least [2](../SOURCES.md#F-58afca2992), preserving within-series autocorrelation and the transect's mean. [999](../SOURCES.md#F-883af86af5) draws; the null distribution of the median cross-lagged asymmetry is computed, not assumed to centre on zero.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-N1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

**`N2`, spatial, contiguity- and depth-preserving.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-CONTIG">A free permutation is the wrong null for anything spatial: on this project's own stations, random connected partitions of matched sizes agree with each other well above chance, by contiguity alone (`docs/data/areas/partition_contiguous.json`).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-CONTIG "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-N2">So relabel cover-loss status only *within* strata of substrate class from GEUS × [1](../SOURCES.md#F-ff725b4398) m bottom-depth band, and only across transects connected on a nearest-neighbour graph whose edges crossing the OSM coastline are removed — the same water graph the partition work uses, never the water-body polygons. Report the observed statistic as **lift over this null**, and report the null's own level.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-N2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-P1">Fetch the three vegetation topics. Count the fill of `Maks dybde begraenset af`, `Daekningsgrad (%)` and both depth-limit columns before using any of them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-P2">Per transect-year, over the growth season this project's light analysis uses, March to September: median cover; nearest-cast Kd **stratified by cast start depth**, never pooled; bottom depth from the transect's own `Vanddybde maks (m)`; light at bed = exp(−Kd·z).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-P3">`C1`: per-transect cross-lagged regression at lags of [1](../SOURCES.md#F-ffc2b9b20e) to [3](../SOURCES.md#F-db5b546583) years, median across transects, against `N1` and `N2`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-P4">`C2`: count transect-years with at least [5](../SOURCES.md#F-1b8d5655f5) consecutive adequate growth seasons and cover below [5](../SOURCES.md#F-d294e85461)%; sensitivity over requirements from [8](../SOURCES.md#F-dfae2980f7)% to [20](../SOURCES.md#F-a8a4b5f18f)%.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-P5">Repeat with the CMEMS `KD490` pixels as the clarity source, streamed by year.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a result would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-LICENSE">A positive `C1` with lift over `N2` licenses: *at these transects, cover change leads clarity change*. It does **not** license a national statement, does not identify the resuspension mechanism — nothing held here measures sediment flux — and cannot separate eelgrass from drifting macroalgae shading unless the epiphyte and drift columns are filled.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-LICENSE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-L4">`C2` is the [L4](../HYPOTHESES.md "Recovery is blocked by something other than the driver") discrimination. Finding light-adequate, cover-absent transects shows the block is **not** light — it does not say what the block is: seed supply, substrate mobility and wasting disease ([T3](../HYPOTHESES.md "Wasting disease with stress-modulated virulence")) all remain. Finding none is consistent with [F3](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae")'s feedback *and* with light simply never having recovered; `C1` is what separates those, which is why both are needed.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-L4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-AF-F3-FAIL">Failure of both leaves [F3](../hypodrafts/F3.md "Loss of eelgrass and macroalgae") unscored at these transects, not refuted elsewhere.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-AF-F3-FAIL "What this claim rests on")</sup>
